snapshot_note: the five *_ow_v2.png sheets and three *_god_battle.png sheets were measured at 08:36 on 2026-10-22; a redraw lane is active, so re-measure before dispatching anything from this file
rule: one entry per sprite sheet in the game, highest priority first; an entry is done when every check in its check block passes

priority_legend.P0: the sprite fails on the ground it stands on (contrast 1.00) or is the white blob; fix before any scene is restaged
priority_legend.P1: the sprite reads as the wrong figure or has no interior structure; fix before the battle scenes are captured
priority_legend.P2: structure or animation is broken but the sprite is legible; fix before the hackathon build
priority_legend.P3: cosmetic; fix when the lane is idle
